paper.title_en: Soft charges and zero modes at null boundaries
paper.abstract_en: Asymptotic symmetries at null boundaries provide a powerful window into the soft sector of field theories, revealing conserved charges and infinite-dimensional symmetry algebras beyond the standard bulk dynamics. While these structures are usually associated with residual gauge transformations, null boundaries also exhibit a characteristic global zero-mode ambiguity, whose physical consequences are less explored. We discuss how this zero mode modifies the canonical structure of field theories at null boundaries. In particular, we show that it gives rise to a new quasilocal edge observable, with consequences to the charge algebra. It can arise on any kind of null boundaries, both at the null infinity and the finite distance such as a black hole horizon.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文探讨了零边界处的软荷和零模及其对电荷代数的影响，与广义相对论基础直接相关，且同时涉及黑洞视界，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 零边界处的软荷与零模
decision.abstract_zh: 零边界处的渐近对称性为场论的软扇区提供了一个强大的窗口，揭示了超越标准体动力学的守恒荷和无限维对称代数。虽然这些结构通常与残余规范变换相关联，但零边界也表现出一种特征性的全局零模歧义，其物理后果较少被探索。我们讨论了这一零模如何修改零边界处场论的正则结构。特别是，我们展示了它产生了一个新的准局域边缘可观测量，对荷代数有影响。它可以在任何类型的零边界上出现，既包括零无穷远处，也包括有限距离处，如黑洞视界。
